_readme: Hand-maintained input for scripts/build-affiliations.mjs (run with: node scripts/build-affiliations.mjs). Run that script after editing this file.
Full workflow for new publications: see 'HOW TO ADD A PUBLICATION' at the top of the list in publications.html.
Institution ids are OpenAlex ids (find one at https://api.openalex.org/institutions/ror:<ROR id> or https://api.openalex.org/institutions?search=<name>) or keys of 'custom'.
home: the institution the map's arcs start from.
papers: downloadBib key -> institution ids, for publications without a DOI. Delete the entry once the DOI link is on the page.
add: DOI -> institution ids that OpenAlex missed. 'node scripts/build-affiliations.mjs --audit' lists candidates from Crossref.
custom: organisations not in OpenAlex (e.g. companies): id -> {name, type, city, country, country_code, lat, lng}. Use an 'x-' prefix for the id.
merge: id -> id to fold it into (wrong or duplicate matches).
hide: ids to drop from the map entirely.
override: id -> fields to replace on an OpenAlex institution (name, city, lat, lng, country_code...).
